name: LOVERGIRL LIV
source:
After years of wishing for a girlfriend, you've landed a date with a cute girl! Can you earn her love, and more importantly... can you handle it? 

[From [url=https://nihomi.itch.io/lovergirl-liv-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
